description: Keep autonomous patrol and walking animation synchronized: authoritative move start/stop overrides prior pose, stopping at the screen edge or duration restores idle, non-move activity and dragging stop translation, and the pet window keeps animation active while unfocused. Uses existing left/right artwork and timing.
validation: pet-interaction.e2e.cjs: both move directions override sleep and cycle five walking frames; explicit stop restores idle
task-integration.e2e.cjs: real autonomous scheduler callback, both directions, window translation plus frame cycling, background throttling disabled, and interaction interrupts translation
